ms.text:
MP1 apparatus:
thermometer and stop-watch
MP2 method:
measure starting temperature and temperature after given time
OR
measure starting temperature and time to drop to given temperature / room temp
MP3 repeat for different starting temperatures
MP4 control variable:
constant volume of water or control variable is volume of water
MP5 table:
columns, with units, for starting temperature and dependent variable
starting temperature / °C
final temperature / °C
OR
starting temperature / °C
time (to drop to given temperature) / s
MP6 analysis:
any one from:
•
compare readings to see if change in initial temperature produces change in dependent variable
•
compare readings to see if change in initial temperature produces change in rate of cooling
•
plot (line) graph (with axes specified)

MP7 additional point:
any one from:
•
at least 5 starting temperatures used
•
repeat for each value of independent variable and take average
•
room temperature constant
•
description of calculating rate of cooling from results
•
use lid every time
